query.description: The last query asked by the user.

question.description: The current question being asked by the user.

client.description: The client from which the ask request is sent

chatHistory.description:
This is the chat history that the user has with the assistant until the last query.

See {@link AiAssistant.Feedback.Question#chatHistory} for more details.

regenerationCount.description:
Number of times the user has requested for a response for the same question.
`0` would be the first response, `1` would be first regeneration request, and so on.

title: `AiAssistant.AskParams` is a type that defines the parameters for an 'ask' request to the AI Assistant.
name: AiAssistant.AskParams
